decided: The instruction every workflow skill carries now treats the two kinds of uncovered call separately: a security choice stops when nothing approved backs it, and an end-user-visible choice stops when no ratified goal covers it, even if a spec requirement supports it.
alternatives: treat both as stopping only when nothing approved backs them, which would change the stop conditions the program ratified
why: The program's ruling on stop conditions defines the user-facing stop by goal coverage, not by precedent; keeping the instruction to that ruling means the stops the first run is graded on are the ones the instruction tells the AI to keep.
detail: Fresh system pass W1 (review-system-2026-11-08T15-28-56Z), option A; option B would amend R-adf-3.
